prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Refine the attached DIHLabs logo into a polished website-ready horizontal logo lockup. Keep the recognizable open circular D/crescent with three diagonal speed strokes, but simplify its contour, even out the stroke weights and negative spaces, and make the emblem optically quiet and balanced beside the wordmark. Exact wordmark text: "DihLabs" (D uppercase, i h lowercase, L uppercase, a b s lowercase). Use restrained medium-weight contemporary grotesk lettering with careful optical kerning, like a well-crafted developer studio identity; avoid heavy sports/esports lettering. Emblem and wordmark must feel drawn by the same hand, with the emblem only slightly taller than the capital letters. Pure solid black shapes on a genuinely transparent background. Flat vector-like precision with smooth curves and sharp clean edges, all shapes connected intentionally, ample clear space. A single centered horizontal logo, no presentation board, no mockup, no shadow, no gradient, no texture, no 3D, no gray, no checkerboard. The output will be thresholded and traced to true SVG paths, so use simple closed shapes and large clean counters. The website uses monochrome surfaces, Schibsted Grotesk interface text, and understated geometric branding; the logo should belong naturally beside that.
conversion: Composite transparency on white, threshold at 50%, trace with Potrace (0.2 tolerance), normalize paths, scale the symbol to 80% and optically center it against the lettering.
